full_prompt_en: A highly detailed science-fiction illustration looks along a broad pedestrian avenue enclosed by immense stacks of urban structures. A heavy elevated bridge crosses the upper third of the square image, carrying an orange-and-white rail vehicle on its right side. The bright vehicle contrasts with layered grey beams, exposed supports and tightly packed platforms beneath it. Tall structures rise along both edges, crowded with balconies, small windows, pipes, rails and irregular projecting ledges. Several lower horizontal spans connect the buildings farther down the avenue. Through the central opening, pale blue sky and distant slender towers provide depth, with a few tiny airborne craft suspended above the city. The lower half is filled by a wide light-beige paved space. Many small pedestrians occupy this foreground and continue in dense groups towards the distance, their varied dark and warm-coloured silhouettes establishing the enormous scale of the surroundings. Long narrow shadows and darker bands cross parts of the paving, while the bridge casts a deeper shade beneath its underside. Sunlit edges and scattered orange accents pick out details among the grey-blue and warm stone structures. The scene remains clear in the foreground, with only the more distant layers softened by a light atmospheric haze. Fine, intricate linework distinguishes cables and built-up surfaces, while broader pale areas keep the crowded view readable. The orange rail vehicle, repeating horizontal bridges and central avenue organize the dense vertical masses into an expansive, busy futuristic cityscape.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅细节丰富的科幻插画，视线沿宽阔步行大道望入巨大城市结构的堆叠之间。一道沉重高架桥横过方形画面上方三分之一处，右侧载着橙白色轨道车辆。亮色车体对照下方层叠灰梁、外露支撑与密集平台。两侧高大结构挤满阳台、小窗、管道、栏杆和不规则悬挑台沿。更远处几道较低水平跨度继续连接两边建筑。中央开口露出浅蓝天与远处细塔，少量微型飞行器悬在城市上方，形成纵深。下半部铺着宽阔浅米色地面，众多细小行人遍布前景，并成群向远处延续。深浅及暖色人影各不相同，交代出周围环境的巨大尺度。狭长投影与暗带穿过部分铺地，高架桥底部则形成更深阴影。受日光照亮的边缘和零星橙色点缀，从灰蓝及暖石色建筑中勾出细节。前景保持清晰，仅较远层次被轻微空气雾感柔化。精密线条区分缆线与密集表面，较宽浅色区域则让拥挤视野仍可辨读。橙色轨道车辆、重复横桥及中央大道，将密集竖向体量组织成广阔繁忙的未来城市景观。
style_prompt_en: The style builds monumental scale through densely layered vertical masses, repeated horizontal spans and very small contrasting accents. Intricate thin lines and irregular surface subdivisions remain sharp in the foreground, then soften gradually with distance. Cool grey-blue and warm stone tones are punctuated by concentrated orange, while broad pale areas prevent the detailed structures from merging. Bright ambient daylight reveals selected edges and casts slender directional shadows alongside deeper shaded undersides. Overlap, diminishing scale and a central open passage establish depth. The composition balances dense construction with readable gaps, creating a busy, expansive and technically intricate visual field.
style_prompt_zh: 这种风格通过密集层叠竖向体量、重复水平跨度和极小对比点建立巨大尺度。复杂细线与不规则表面分区在前景清楚，随距离逐渐柔化。冷灰蓝、暖石色中集中点缀橙色，宽阔浅面使细节密集的结构不至于融合。明亮环境日光揭示局部边缘，投出纤细方向性阴影，同时保留底面深影。遮挡、递减尺度与中央开放通道建立纵深。构图以可辨空隙平衡密集结构，形成繁忙广阔、细节精密的视觉场域。
theme_en: An elevated train above the crowded street of a dense vertical city
theme_zh: 层叠高密城市中高架列车下的拥挤街道
name: Massive scale
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
